---
description: "Use when creating or redesigning website sections, pages, layouts, or styles. Follow the Chaitanya Keralam design system."
applyTo: ["components/**/*.tsx", "app/**/*.tsx", "app/**/*.css"]
---

# Website design system

- Before designing or implementing a new website section, read the complete `docs/LANDING-PAGE-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`. Treat it as the source of truth for the site's visual language, tokens, components, accessibility, motion, and responsive behavior.
- Check the existing site components and styles as well, and follow the project's current implementation patterns while applying the design system.
- Do not introduce conflicting visual tokens or patterns. If a requirement appears to conflict with the design system, call out the conflict before proceeding.
